title: Raiders of Old California
description: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
description: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E06 — Oil Land
After being wrongfully jailed on a murder charge, Cisco and Pancho escape to capture the real murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E07 — Chain Lightning
Cisco is challenged by a man who seeks revenge after being jailed.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E08 — Medicine Flats
Cisco and Pancho hope to imprison the leader of a rustling ring.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E09 — Railroad Land Rush
A con man resorts to murder in a phony land promotion scheme.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E07 — Sam Bass
Frankie befriends an outlaw after his gang robs the train.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E08 — Johnny Ringo
While investigating a train robbery, Matt Clark learns about Johnny Ringo; Frankie gets a job doing undercover work; Matt tracks Johnny down.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E09 — The Dalton Gang
Former deputies plan on robbing a gold shipment after their brother is killed.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
Doc Holiday
Detective Matt Clark and his partner Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to find Doc Holliday with suspicion that Holliday is involved in the gang activity there; starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E32 — Death at Dawn
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E01 — Showdown
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E03 — Badge Without Honor
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E04 — The Mill
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Singing Billy (Roy Rogers) settles a case of mistaken identity with his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette).

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Santa Fe Trail
description: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.

title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
description: A rodeo stunt rider (Cameron Mitchell) meets a woman (Audrey Long) who comes between him and his trick horse, Bess.

title: Daughter of the West
description: A convent-raised woman (Martha Vickers) learns of her American Indian heritage through romance with an educated Navajo (Philip Reed) during the 1880s.

title: Mason of the Mounted
description: A young constable searches for a murderer and finds the suspect managing a prosperous horse-stealing gang.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: A Lust to Kill
description: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

title: Law of the Pampas
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekick (Russell Hayden) head for South America to deliver cattle.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E10 — The Will
A stage line driver is framed in the looting of strongboxes by the stage line owner and freighter.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E12 — Renegade Son
After a woman is wrongfully jailed, Cisco and Pancho plan to trap the real murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E15 — Lynching Story
Cisco and Pancho prove that an office manager and his followers are murderers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E16 — Newspaper Crusaders
A gambler's thugs beat up a crusading newspaperman.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E11 — The Younger Brothers
The Younger Brothers, certain their past with the Quantrill Riders prevents them from living an honest life, plan a bold bank robbery that Matt and Frankie attempt to thwart.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E12 — John Wesley Hardin
Matt investigates the deaths of two Osage Indians.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E13 — Joaquin Murietta
The 1850s California gold fields are home to notorious bandit Joaquin Murietta; Matt and Frankie arrive to track him down, but he kidnaps Frankie; Matt and Captain Love trail Murietta to the bitter end.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E14 — Tiburcio Vasquez
Tiburcio Vasquez vows vengeance against Anglos after his sister Dolores is killed; Matt and Frankie try to stop his years of terror in Southern California after a railroad agent is killed with the help of a local priest.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E09 — The Medicine Man
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find Wenatchgo, an old and respected medicine man, wandering in the forest; they discover that the elderly man has been driven out of the tribe by a younger and ambitious rival.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E10 — The Servant
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find a young Irish girl, Bridget, alone in the woods; she is running away from a man named Stark who claims to own her.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E11 — The Search
Hawkeye and Chingachgook rescue an elderly woman from two Indians who have kidnapped her and were about to take her back to their tribe.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E12 — Snake Tattoo
Hawkeye and Chingachgook set out to help a young Indian boy who has been raised by a white man, but they soon discover that the boy is the long-lost son of a Cree tribal chief.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E13 — False Witness
Army payroll messengers are found dead, murdered by a gang of bandits, and the payroll stolen; in order to find the killers, Hawkeye and Chingachgook go undercover as managers of a local trading post.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E14 — Powder Keg
Fur trader McKenzie initiates a war between the Hurons and the nearby settlement where another trader is taking his business.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E40 — Scapegoat
After a long winter, the Tuscarora tribe struggles for survival; Hawkeye and Chingachgook set out to help. Starring John Hart as Hawkeye, and Lon Chaney Jr as Chingachgook.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E16 — Way Station
The daughter of Mingo Chief Nocona is desired by two warring tribesmen.

title: Shine on Harvest Moon
description: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

title: Code of the Fearless
description: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Idaho
description: A state ranger (Roy Rogers) clears a crusading judge framed for a bank robbery.

title: Ghost Town Gold
description: The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: Roll, Thunder, Roll
description: Red Ryder (Jim Bannon) and Little Beaver (Don Kay Reynolds) help a Mexican Robin Hood framed by raiders.

title: Mason of the Mounted
description: A young constable searches for a murderer and finds the suspect managing a prosperous horse-stealing gang.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: Colorado Sundown
description: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: In Old Cheyenne
description: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
description: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: Man From Music Mountain
description: A radio-singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) turns sheriff to save a sheep woman (Ruth Terry) from a cattleman (Paul Kelly).

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: The Range Busters
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, John King, Max Terhune) make their cowboy-trio debut, hunting a phantom killer.

title: The Fighting Redhead
description: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
description: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

title: Springtime in the Sierras
description: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: The Over-the-Hill Gang
description: A retired Texas Ranger (Pat O'Brien) summons three old-timers to help him clean up Boulder.
